summary: A financial disclosure the clerk stamps one minute past the cutoff keeps a council candidate off the ballot.
realLife: A council candidate was disqualified when the city recorded his disclosure filing a minute after the deadline; the recorder had given the wrong date earlier and corrected it, and the city refused an exception.
sources: FOX 13 Salt Lake City, council candidate disqualified for filing one minute late, Aug. 13, 2019: https://www.fox13now.com/2019/08/13/draper-city-council-candidate-disqualified-for-filing-documents-one-minute-late
inGame: needs: a received-at time on a filing and a cutoff the clerk cannot waive

turns.turn: The form is stamped in time
turns.writesBack: the candidate stays on the ballot

turns.turn: The clock says one minute late and the city holds
turns.pulledBy: a firm official and a fair rule
